datatype.name: FloorCount
datatype.definition: A non-negative count of storeys (floors) in a building.

concept.name: Building
concept.definition: A roofed, permanent construction with walls, standing more or less independently, intended for human occupancy or use.

provenance.source: ISO 6707-1:2020 Buildings and civil engineering works — Vocabulary — Part 1: General terms

property.name: floorCount
property.definition: Number of storeys the building has above and below ground.

provenance.note: Per-building values are sourced at L2.

concept.name: Room
concept.definition: An interior space within a building, enclosed by walls, floor and ceiling and normally entered through a door. A Room is a PART OF a Building (mereology), it is not a kind of Building.

provenance.source: ISO 6707-1:2020 Buildings and civil engineering works — Vocabulary — Part 1: General terms

property.name: floorArea
property.definition: The usable floor area enclosed by the room.

provenance.note: Per-room values are sourced at L2.
